2609.15722.title: Data storytelling meets interpretable machine learning: Decoding AI decisions for non-experts without revealing sensitive data and model details
2609.15722.paper_summary: AI-driven automated decision-making requires both predictive performance and interpretability. Recent advances in interpretable machine learning (IML) provide tools for explaining model predictions, but the technical complexity of these explanations may hinder accessibility to non-experts. To address this challenge, this study integrates data storytelling with IML to enhance the explainability of AI-generated decisions for a broader audience. Following the design science research (DSR) paradigm, this study proposes a formal definition of data storytelling in IML, introduces the DIST Pyramid to align data storytelling with IML, and presents the I-P-O Model to describe their interactions. It further develops an architecture to explain AI decisions through distinct "What-if" and "Why-not" event-generation processes. The architecture also employs data desensitization to protect sensitive input data. To validate the approach, a case study is conducted with the Boston Housing dataset, using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) values and large language models (LLMs) to generate data stories with And-But-Therefore (ABT) structures. An empirical evaluation shows that 76.4% and 74.3% of respondents rated the "What-if" and "Why-not" data stories as more comprehensible, with significantly higher accessibility scores than traditional SHAP visualizations. The paper concludes with the presentation of a narrative interpretation framework that integrates IML and data storytelling, thereby expanding the research scope as well as the practical applicability of AI decision-making.
2609.15722.paper_summary_zh: AI 驅動的自動決策需要預測性能和可解釋性。最近在可解釋機器學習（IML）方面的進展提供了解釋模型預測的工具，但這些解釋的技術複雜性可能會妨礙非專家的可及性。為了解決這一挑戰，本研究將數據敘事與 IML 相結合，以增強 AI 生成決策的可解釋性，使其能夠面向更廣泛的受眾。根據設計科學研究（DSR）範式，本研究提出了 IML 中數據敘事的正式定義，介紹了 DIST 金字塔以對齊數據敘事與 IML，並提出了 I-P-O 模型來描述它們之間的互動。它進一步開發了一個架構，通過明確的「如果」和「為什麼不」事件生成過程來解釋 AI 決策。該架構還採用了數據去敏感化來保護敏感的輸入數據。為了驗證這一方法，進行了一個案例研究，使用波士頓房價數據集，利用 SHapley 加性解釋（SHAP）值和大型語言模型（LLMs）生成具有「和-但-因此」（ABT）結構的數據故事。實證評估顯示，76.4% 和 74.3% 的受訪者認為「如果」和「為什麼不」的數據故事更易於理解，其可及性得分顯著高於傳統的 SHAP 可視化。本文最後提出了一個敘事解釋框架，整合了 IML 和數據敘事，從而擴展了研究範疇以及 AI 決策的實際應用性。
